input.summary:
P0 east bedroom: layout designed and checked on a scratch copy (walk OK, min light 9, fit OK): two white beds, two barrels as dresser with a standing lantern and a potted poppy.
In the merged build it places nothing: shell-west fills the room interior with air (line 16), and runParts locks air, so all 8 writes are refused.
The room module is ready once shell-west leaves the interior unwritten; I added this to plan.md Notes.
left: Blocked: shell-west (parts/shell-west.mjs line 16) fills x 3..12, y 2..top, z 14..20 with air, so runParts refuses every furniture write in P0 east bedroom (8 refused, 0 placed). Needs shell-west to carve only the envelope, not the room interiors.

P0 partition x 10 must be solid at z 14,15,17..20 for y 6..8 (door at (10,6..7,16) only): the beds' heads stand against it. The shell currently leaves those cells air (the plan shows them as doorways), so bed A's head would be against air.

bed() in the build library never places on air: its air test /(^|_)air$/ misses the 'minecraft:air' ids that g.get returns, so it returns false for every bed. parts/room-7.mjs uses a local bedAt() with a fixed test; the library should be fixed (build.mjs line ~326) and the local helper dropped.

The P0 attic ladder (x 11, z 17, y 6..10) passes through the room's lane column x 11; the room is walkable with it (ladders are climbable, not solid), but re-run `$MCD room` on the merged build to confirm.

Not verified in the merged build: render, and the checklist items for this room are not ticked because nothing is built yet. The lantern is standing on a barrel (hanging needs a block at y 9, which the roof part decides).

waste.what: Found by trial that bed() silently returns false on every air cell, then re-ran the build to see the refusals.
waste.cost: about 3 build cycles and one scratch harness
waste.tool: mcd room should flag a bed() that places nothing, and bed() should use the same air test as the rest of the library (the regex must match 'minecraft:air').

waste.what: Did not know the shell locks interior air until the refusal; had to read runParts and shell-west to find it.
waste.tool: runParts should print the owning part for each refused cell (for example 'owned by shell west, air'), and the room check should warn when a room's box is already locked.

waste.what: Wrote the layout's cell coordinates by hand (beds, barrels, lantern) from the floor grid, then re-tested on a scratch copy without the lock.
waste.tool: A helper that places a bed pair and a dresser inside a room box from the plan grid, using the room's walls and doorways as constraints, with a scratch-apply option that skips the lock for testing.

companions.task: Check the light for this room after shell-west is fixed, and decide whether the lantern on the barrel or a second lamp is needed.
Build the partition at x 10 with its one doorway at z 16 (y 6..8), so the beds' heads have a solid wall.
